info.name: Intrecci del passato
info.plot: Allegra sogna di entrare nella compagnia di musical Eleven O'Clock, ma sua madre Caterina non lo accetta. La vita di Allegra viene sconvolta quando trova un misterioso braccialetto che la trasporta nel 1994, anno in cui Caterina aveva la sua età e, iniziata una propria carriera nella Eleven O'Clock, viveva all'ombra di Cocó, la nonna di Allegra. Riuscirà Allegra a cambiare il passato?

episodes.name: The Bracelet
episodes.plot: Allegra auditions to join the Eleven O' Clock music hall company behind Caterina's back. Caterina, her mother, doesn't want her to be part of that world. When she finds out the truth, they have a fight. Allegra meets her grandmother Cocó for the first time.

episodes.name: Back to the Past
episodes.plot: Allegra receives some good news about Caterina in the present and tells Félix what happened. Allegra tries to make the bracelet work again so she can go back to the past to change her mom's life. Greta has a plan to sabotage Caterina so she can get the main role in the 1994 play.

episodes.name: The Moment
episodes.plot: Caterina goes back to her home in the present. Cocó, Caterina and Allegra have dinner together for the first time. Caterina finds out that Allegra auditioned again and the dinner ends in disaster.

translations.value: Caterina goes back to her home in the present. Cocó, Caterina and Allegra have dinner together for the first time. Caterina finds out that Allegra auditioned again and the dinner ends in disaster.

episodes.name: CD Room
episodes.plot: Allegra starts making friends with Caterina in 1994. Marco invites her to the concert he's giving with Diego. Cocó forbids Caterina to go to the concert, but she refuses to give in so easily. Caterina confesses her real passion to Allegra.

episodes.name: Three Gardenias
episodes.plot: Allegra tries to reason with Caterina. Lucía confesses her big secret to Allegra. Caterina confronts Cocó in 1994 and has a fight with Allegra. The three Sharp women have a moment of union in the present.

episodes.name: Rewind
episodes.plot: Allegra and Lucía organize a special surprise for Caterina. Allegra tries to persuade Caterina to trust her again. Félix and Allegra talk to Diego in the present and investigate what happened during the opening night of the play.

episodes.name: The Big Leap
episodes.plot: Allegra persuades Caterina to forgive her and she helps her rehearse to get the main role. All of a sudden, Cocó pays a visit to Allegra in the bookshop and she realizes Cocó never left the country.

episodes.name: Lucía's Secret
episodes.plot: Allegra and Félix talk to Barbara about the opening night. Lucía reveals something to Allegra that puts at risk her relationship with Marco. Allegra and Sofía challenge each other.

episodes.name: Just One Day
episodes.plot: Allegra and Sofía compete in a dance challenge. Félix doesn't hesitate to put his future at risk so that Allegra can fulfill her dream in the present. Allegra surprises everybody with a last-minute change on the opening night of 1994.

episodes.plot: Allegra tries to save Marco and avoid the fight between Caterina and Cocó before she runs out of time. Cocó makes a decision in 1994 that will change her life forever.

translations.title: Disney Intertwined
translations.overview: Allegra dreams of joining the Eleven O' Clock music hall company, but her mother, Caterina, won't accept that. Allegra's life changes drastically when she finds a mysterious bracelet that takes her to 1994, the year Caterina was her age and was starting her career in Eleven O' Clock while she lived in Coco's shadow. Cocó is Allegra's grandmother. Will Allegra be able to change the past?
translations.tagline: To fulfill her dreams, she will have to change the past.

translations.overview: Allegra sueña con unirse a la compañía de teatro musical Eleven O'clock, pero su madre, Caterina, se niega a aceptarlo. La vida de Allegra cambia drásticamente cuando encuentra un brazalete mágico que la transporta a 1994, el año en que Caterina tenía su edad y daba comienzo a su carrera en Eleven O'clock mientras vivía a la sombra de Cocó, la abuela de Allegra. ¿Será capaz Allegra de cambiar el pasado?
